description: This file contains shell script functions related to the management and upgrade procedures of a device with eMMC storage, specifically for the uDPU platform. It includes functions for checking device presence, partition preparation, formatting, and performing system upgrades.

methods.name: udpu_check_emmc
methods.description: Checks for available eMMC device based on system files.

methods.name: udpu_part_prep
methods.description: Unmounts and prepares a partition for use.

methods.name: udpu_do_part_check
methods.description: Validates existing partitions or creates new as needed.

methods.name: udpu_do_initial_setup
methods.description: Formats essential partitions during initial setup.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_uDPU
methods.description: Performs the overall upgrade process including firmware extraction and partition updates.
